analysis.purpose: Searches a float array for the nearest-element index, checking adjacent distances and endpoints. Its specific game use is unknown; positive count and strictly ascending finite input are inferred preconditions.
analysis.observed_abi: ABI-compatible signature: s32 game_libs_func_0002F1B8(f32 key, f32 *arr, s32 n). Inputs are $f12, $a1 and $a2; integer index returns in $v0. No stack frame, calls, imports or globals.
evidence: Original game_libs Text offsets 0x2F1B8–0x2F287 form one 52-instruction function. Internal branches connect both search directions; predecessor and successor have independent boundaries.
Array addressing scales the index by four and reads f32 values at relative offsets 0, +4 and -4. No aggregate field layout is accessed.
Recovered callgraph has no callers, resolved calls or unresolved callsites; original instructions contain no JAL/JALR.
Inspected neighboring gl_func_0002E354 and gl_func_0002F288. Their object accesses provide no evidence of a shared layout with this scalar-array leaf; no five-function layout family was identified.
Updating mid before the shared return eliminates the previous branch-delay mismatch; byte-based indexing reproduces the base-first addu.
Both compiled function bodies equal immutable expected bytes, SHA256 6072a55b8f1b49df142ba45e3f2c0a9cf5ea5066e2a2b097a90e2278ecbc2c60.
ROM MD5 is fa27089c425dbab99f19245c5c997613; byte comparison and all six compressed-block checks passed.
Only src/game_libs/game_libs_post.c is modified. Experiments remain under build/orchestration-scratch/.

Fresh upstream port: original compiler in both modes, complete native call/data USO identity checks, exact source-generated tables/constants, exact host function bytes, full ROM and all six strict original code-block payloads.
hypotheses: n is the array element count.
Valid callers supply a positive count and strictly ascending finite values.
Under those preconditions, strict distance comparisons retain the current midpoint on equal-distance ties.
unknowns: Original typedefs, caller identities and application-level use of the index remain unrecovered.
Behavioral guarantees for empty arrays, duplicates and nonfinite inputs are unproved.
Missing relocation and indirect-edge coverage limits caller discovery; absence of recovered callers does not prove the function is unused.

The surrounding host definition preserves compiler/RoData context; the required independently compiled C implementation is src/match_imports/game_libs_func_0002F1B8.c. This is not a proof of original source spelling or whole-program portable source.

limitations: Indirect calls and missing recovered relocations stay unresolved; alias value zero is not an identity.
Observed indirect calls prove possible executed targets only; preserve indirect C dispatch and other unknown runtime targets.
